note: Ameriabank's tariffs for individuals (edition 50, effective 11 July 2026), Standard column: account management costs 1,000 drams a calendar half-year where the average daily balance is not above 50,000 drams, a charge not applied until and including 30 June 2027, so it stands at nothing until 1 July 2027. Its other waiver, average cash flows of at least 150,000 drams, isn't written; opening charges aren't modelled.
